_readme: The noodle strip along the bottom of the home hero's first screen (Preston via BOSS, 7 Nov 2026: "more noodles on the front"), in order. Noodles with a shoot photo that are NOT in the home gallery's 24, so the first screen and the gallery don't repeat. Picked one brand per round, as the gallery is (meon-2, 7 Nov 2026). npm run build stops if a slug has no photo or is also in the gallery. scripts/make_thumbs.py makes their 160 px copies (<slug>-t160.webp).
